segments.comment: Reuses the D:3 general store found for recipes/dokick.c/kick-shop-door-pay-damage-5520005 with a new player name. After the wizard-mode level teleport, Ctrl-T places the hero inside the shop on an axe at (77,16). The hero picks it up unpaid and throws it west; it lands on a costly square of the same shop, so check_shop_obj() takes its subfrombill() branch and removes the axe from the bill.
